summary: Reproduced at the fix parent 13fa9ca2cf41 (also the latest affected commit); the fix could not be evaluated. At 13fa9ca2cf41 a fully EXL3 BlockSparseMLP (is_quantized True, so the one-token fused branch runs) given shared_experts returned exactly the routed-only output (max abs diff 0.0) and missed routed + shared by 0.247, the full size of the shared output: the shared addition was skipped, as stated. At the fix b8c830c17f53 conversion of the same fixture raised TypeError 'blocksparse_mlp_routing(): incompatible function arguments' at exllamav3/modules/block_sparse_mlp.py:348: that commit's Python passes five arguments, but its own extension source (tree c9263a8f, built from that tree) takes four. Upstream 39ded1b7b83c ('Fix regression', two commits later) removes the extra argument; it is not a recorded fix and was not tested.
what_ran: repro.py generates a tiny random 1-layer MixtralForCausalLM checkpoint (hidden 256, intermediate 512, 4 experts, top 2) with Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct tokenizer files, quantizes it to 4 bpw EXL3 with the repository's own converter at the commit under test (convert_model parser/prepare/main, in-process, 4x256 calibration), then constructs exllamav3.modules.BlockSparseMLP directly with MixtralModel's arguments plus shared_experts = a GatedMLP over expert 0's EXL3 tensors, and a second identical BlockSparseMLP without shared_experts. One token of shape (1, 1, 256) is forwarded through both and through the standalone GatedMLP on physical GPU 1, and the outputs are compared.
limits: Synthetic random weights; BlockSparseMLP is constructed directly because no built-in model constructor at these commits supplies shared_experts. The shared branch reuses expert 0's tensors, not a separate shared expert. Default (non-DeepSeek-V3) routing only. The fix commit b8c830c17f53 could not run the default routing path at all, so the fix is unconfirmed; 39ded1b7b83c was not tested. One GPU (RTX 3090).

model.repo_id: synthetic tiny MixtralForCausalLM generated by repro.py (tokenizer from Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct), quantized by repro.py at each tested commit
